title: DRAFT EXPERIMENT: an interface taking a caller-supplied callback states its answer to an invalid callback return

sections.context: Disposable test fixture, not a canonical decision. It shows a decision referencing a pattern sidecar. It is one interpretation motivated by proposed DEC-0194 clauses 2.e and 5, which state broad criteria and do not contain this concrete rule.
sections.decision:
1. An interface that takes a caller-supplied callback states the failure it answers when the callback's return is invalid.

2. That definition has a verification definition that verifies it.

3. That definition has a same-subject obligation.
sections.consequences: Assessment derives one independently required instance of the rule per inventoried interface. The inventory is supplied, not discovered.
